themoviechannel.us.title: Basic Instinct
themoviechannel.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Love and Monsters
themoviechannel.us.description: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Urban Cowboy
themoviechannel.us.description: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition. (Drama) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
themoviechannel.us.description: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve. (Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Flypaper
themoviechannel.us.description: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: View From the Top
themoviechannel.us.description: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for. (Comedy, Romance, Drama) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
themoviechannel.us.description: When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship. (Children, Comedy) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. (Comedy) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Kingpin
themoviechannel.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
themoviechannel.us.description: The Brothers Grimm, Wilhelm and Jacob, are dysfunctional schemers who go from town to town putting on shows that convince inhabitants they are getting rid of demons. After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work. (Fantasy, Adventure, Mystery, Thriller) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Hugo
themoviechannel.us.description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home. (Adventure, Fantasy, Drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: Mr. Holmes
themoviechannel.us.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement. (Mystery, Drama) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Ghosts
themoviechannel.us.description: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. (Comedy drama) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: Three Wishes
themoviechannel.us.description: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. (Fantasy) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: The Fitzgerald Family Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: Rifts emerge among family members when their long-estranged patriarch decides to come home for the holidays. (Holiday, Comedy drama) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: Smoke Signals
themoviechannel.us.description: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. (Comedy drama) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Smart People
themoviechannel.us.description: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2008

themoviechannel.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
themoviechannel.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: The Contractor
themoviechannel.us.description: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: There Will Be Blood
themoviechannel.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Dutchman
themoviechannel.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: The Faculty
themoviechannel.us.description: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream
themoviechannel.us.description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity. - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 2
themoviechannel.us.description: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college. - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 3
themoviechannel.us.description: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 4
themoviechannel.us.description: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour. - 2011

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Food, Air, Toilet
trutv.us.description: Joe, Sal, Q and Murr showcase their creative vision by unveiling their new inventions and learn what it takes to get a date in the digital age; the losing joker embraces the role of a lifetime. (Reality, Comedy) - 2021-08-05

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - A Tasteful Episode
trutv.us.description: Murr, Q, Joe and Sal prove their good taste, and later prove they can hack it in the professional world; the safe guys give the losing joker a semi that he must show off to an unsuspecting crowd. (Reality, Comedy) - 2021-08-12

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Moist Richard
trutv.us.description: Sal, Q, Murr, and Joe take the law into their own hands, and they misplace the trust of their own children; finally, the losing joker must pod up with a stranger. (Reality, Comedy) - 2021-08-19

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Impractical Jokers Awards
trutv.us.description: Four longtime friends compete to embarrass each other with a series of hilarious dares; if they refuse, they lose. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-11-03

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Eric André
trutv.us.description: Sal, Q and Murr clear the room as eccentric exterminators and produce a controversial infomercial; comic Eric André drops by to give the losing Joker an awkward release. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-04-02

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Jillian Bell
trutv.us.description: Q, Murr, and Sal learn a tough lesson about the corporate chain of command before starting a white-collar revolution; the losing joker must play husband to special guest Jillian Bell. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-06-16

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Colin Jost
trutv.us.description: Murr, Sal, and Q learn a hard lesson about being kind to food service professionals, before heading off to give rock solid relationship advice; the losing joker is in for a shock, as his punishment is led by Colin Jost. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-06-23

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Rob Riggle
trutv.us.description: Murr, Sal, and Q perform a questionable taste test; the guys work off some of those calories with some CrossFit; Rob Riggle lets the losing joker show off that new swole gym body. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-06-30

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Chris Jericho
trutv.us.description: Sal, Q, and Murr slather on the charm for a commercial shoot before focusing on delivering some hard truths; finally, Chris Jericho turns heel on the losing joker. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-07-07

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Adam Pally & Jon Gabrus
trutv.us.description: Murr, Sal and Q learn that a good babysitter can be hard to find, before going off to perform some consumer research; Adam Pally and Jon Gabrus shock the losing joker with their devious punishment. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-07-14

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - David Cross
trutv.us.description: Q, Murr and Sal finally clean out their garages before giving truly spooky presentations; in the end, David Cross brings a sense of danger to the losing joker and makes a memory they're sure to remember. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-07-21

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Method Man
trutv.us.description: Q, Murr, and Sal play mad scientists and answer for their crimes in the form of a really dumb survey; the losing joker participates in the new talk show, "Real Talk With Meth," led by Method Man. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-07-28

trutv.us.title: The Carbonaro Effect - Vegan Plant
trutv.us.description: Michael feeds a cannibalistic plant at a garden center; he sells a necktie that literally suits itself; at a hockey rink, Michael's assistant is speechless with a trick so electric it melts the ice. (Entertainment, Comedy) - 2018-12-27

trutv.us.title: The Carbonaro Effect - Sorcery or Science
trutv.us.description: Michael sweetens a woman's day, causing a chocolate bunny to eat her ring; he inflates pretzels at a baseball stadium snack stand; one of Michael's tricks gets flushed down the tubes. (Entertainment, Comedy) - 2019-01-10

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Filming With the Stars
trutv.us.description: The jokers revisit the celebrity guests they worked with throughout the season by highlighting their most memorable moments and rolling out some bonus content that has never been seen before. (Reality, Comedy) - 2022-08-11

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Bret Michaels
trutv.us.description: Sal, Q and Murr are crashing and burning into product displays and hiding in tight spaces, but one of them must face the music with celebrity guest Bret Michaels. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-02-09

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Post Malone
trutv.us.description: The jokers give unsolicited etiquette advice and live tape strange product reviews; one lucky joker takes all the blame for celebrity guest Post Malone. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-02-16

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Anthony Davis
trutv.us.description: From working remotely to pitching unconventional business ideas with Steve Byrne, one Joker has a shot at winning a pair of highly sought-after sneakers thanks to NBA star Anthony Davis. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-02-23

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - John Mayer
trutv.us.description: Joined by John Mayer, the Jokers must convince unsuspecting temps to accompany them to a business dinner; the losing Joker has to face the wrath of angry Mayer fans in a humiliating punishment. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-03-02

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Kesha
trutv.us.description: Sal, Q, and Murr fall head over heels for someone they just met; a heated debate with pro wrestler MJF; a Joker discovers an untapped clairvoyant talent they possess with guest star Kesha. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-03-09

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Sideline Smack Talk
trutv.us.description: A special episode hosted by Casey Jost and former NFL player Eddie Jackson as they spend time reviewing nail-biting clips of never-before-seen moments from Season 10. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-03-19

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Paul Scheer
trutv.us.description: Unable to pull off this week's pickleball and coffee shop challenges, the losing Jokers are forced to participate in an overseas game show hosted by special guest Paul Scheer. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-03-30

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Kal Penn
trutv.us.description: The jokers are posing as salesmen and must sell their bizarre products to focus group participants, then attempt a challenge that turns out to be a mouthful; Sal finds himself in a stinky situation in tonight's punishment with guest star Kal Penn. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-04-06

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Bruce Campbell
trutv.us.description: The jokers are dishing out as waiters and later grilled by news anchor Rosanna Scotto; finally, the losing joker is in for a horrific treat with guest star Bruce Campbell. (Reality, Comedy) - 2023-04-13

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wizard of Oz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Young Dorothy (Dorothy Dwan), a farm girl from Kansas, discovers that she's actually Princess Dorothea, the royal heir to a faraway kingdom called Oz. Suddenly, a powerful tornado whisks Dorothy, her uncle Henry (Frank Alexander) and three farmhands to the magical kingdom. There Dorothy is hailed as the queen of the land by all except authoritarian Prime Minister Kruel (Joseph Swickard), who casts a curse on Dorothy in an attempt to maintain his dictatorial reign. (Fantasy) - 1925

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Stolen Kisses
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The third in a series of films featuring François Truffaut's alter-ego, Antoine Doinel (Jean-Pierre Léaud), the story resumes with Antoine being discharged from military service. His sweetheart Christine's (Claude Jade) father lands Antoine a job as a security guard, which he promptly loses. Stumbling into a position assisting a private detective, Antoine falls for his employers' seductive wife, Fabienne (Delphine Seyrig), and finds that he must choose between the older woman and Christine. (Comedy drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Soft Skin
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While flying to Lisbon, Portugal, to give a lecture, a writer and magazine editor, Pierre Lachenay (Jean Desailly), encounters an attractive flight attendant, Nicole (Françoise Dorléac), and winds up spending the night with her. What was intended to be a one-night stand becomes a tumultuous extramarital affair once he gets back to Paris and his wife (Nelly Benedetti) and kids. Pierre tries to keep the affair secret, but, when his wife suspects him, she snaps. (Romance) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Happiness Ahead
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A bored heiress (Josephine Hutchinson) leaves high society and falls in love with a window washer (Dick Powell). (Musical comedy) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Here Comes Happiness
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A rich girl (Mildred Coles) loves a sandblaster (Edward Norris) instead of the socialite (Richard Ainley) her mother wants her to marry. (Romance) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Princess O'Rourke
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Princess Maria (Olivia de Havilland) and her uncle (Charles Coburn) are in Washington, D.C., where it is hoped she will meet a suitable man to marry. After a number of misfires on the romance front, Maria flies to San Francisco, sedating herself beforehand to combat her fear of flying. Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters. (Romantic comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A toothpaste tycoon's daughter (Joan Blondell) sells an inventor's new brand to teach her father a lesson. (Comedy) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: There Goes My Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Eager to break free of her constrained life, heiress Joan Butterfield (Virginia Bruce) runs away from her grandfather's yacht just as reporter Bill Spencer (Fredric March) arrives to get a rare photo of her. Befriended by the kind Peggy (Patsy Kelly), Joan takes an assumed name and moves in with Peggy, then joins her working at Butterfield's department store. Bill, who has begun an article on Joan, visits the store and, recognizing her there, realizes that he has stumbled upon a hot story. (Romance) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Repent at Leisure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A young man falls in love with his boss's daughter. (Comedy drama) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Love and Learn
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A New York socialite (Martha Vickers) plays working girl around two struggling songwriters (Jack Carson, Robert Hutton). (Musical comedy) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Richest Girl in the World
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dorothy Hunter (Miriam Hopkins), the richest girl in the world, has never shown her face to the public. When she arrives in America, Dorothy switches places with her secretary, Sylvia (Fay Wray), to avoid the press. But after Dorothy's fiancé (George Meeker) proclaims his love for another woman, she wonders if any man can love her for more than her money. Still disguised as a secretary, Dorothy falls for Tony (Joel McCrea) and puts him through a series of tests to prove his affections. (Comedy) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bride by Mistake
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has. (Drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sun Valley Serenade
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: As a surefire way to receive good press, bandleader Phil Corey (Glenn Miller) and his ensemble decide to adopt a war refugee. When it turns out that their adoptee isn't a child, but a pretty Scandinavian woman named Karen Benson (Sonja Henie), it leads to a flirtatious relationship with the group's pianist, Ted Scott (John Payne), who is already involved with singer Vivian Dawn (Lynn Bari). As the band heads to snowy Idaho for a gig, romantic drama, skiing, ice skating and musical numbers ensue. (Musical, Romance) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Orchestra Wives
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a touring swing band arrives in her small town, Connie Ward (Ann Rutherford) falls hard for trumpeter Bill Abbot (George Montgomery) and decides to marry him on a whim -- since the band is leaving as quickly as it arrived. Quite unprepared for her new lifestyle, Connie struggles to adjust to the constant travel from one town to another, and also to the pettiness of the other musicians' wives. Eventually, the marriage and the band break up, but Bill is determined to make it all right again. (Musical, Romance) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Birth of the Blues
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jeff Lambert (Bing Crosby), who has grown up in New Orleans surrounded by black music, determines to start a band featuring white cornet player Memphis (Brian Donlevy). However, the Basin Street Hotshots are rejected from several venues for playing "black" jazz, until singer Betty Lou Cobb (Mary Martin) insists they be hired as her backup band. The band finds success until Jeff and Memphis fall out over Betty Lou, then get entangled with gangster Blackie (J. Carrol Naish). (Musical) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Girl Crazy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Distracted by female students and performing poorly in the classroom, Danny Churchill Jr. (Mickey Rooney) moves west to a university that his father believes is free of temptation. Soon, though, Danny strikes up a friendship with Ginger Gray (Judy Garland). When Ginger, whose family runs the all-male college, explains that the school has money troubles, creative Danny puts together a big fundraiser. The event highlights their song-and-dance skills and also cements their bond. (Musical comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Strike Up the Band
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Teenage drummer Jimmy Connors dreams of winning the contest for school bands hosted by popular band leader Paul Whiteman (himself). In order to enter, Jimmy and his pals, including charming vocalist Mary Holden, must accumulate $200 for the train ride to Chicago, where the contest will be held. Jimmy and his friends decide to put on an epic student play to raise the funds they need, but a sudden illness threatens to cost the band their chance. (Musical comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pot o' Gold
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band that constantly practices. Soon, Jimmy finds himself trying to help the band by getting them gigs and trying to reconcile the family with his uncle, an avid music-hater. (Musical comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: God Is My Co-Pilot
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Col. Robert L. Scott is an adept fighter pilot who unfortunately finds himself too old to fly fighter planes in World War II. Assigned to India, he later meets Maj. Gen. Claire L. Chennault, who commands the famous "Flying Tigers" squadron in China. Chennault finally allows Scott to learn combat flying techniques on an obsolete training plane. Scott is so good that Chennault gives him his wish -- he will fly combat missions with the Tigers. (Biography) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: My Wild Irish Rose
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this musical, Chauncey Olcott (Dennis Morgan) -- a character based on the real-life 19th-century singer-songwriter -- starts off as a minstrel show performer, but his life and career completely change when singer Lillian Russell (Andrea King) gives him a starring role in a Broadway show. Olcott's girlfriend, Rose (Arlene Dahl), gets jealous, suspecting an affair. But in spite of his relationship battles, Olcott's star rises with a series of ballads, including the title track. (Musical) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Two Guys From Milwaukee
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While waiting for his Balkan country to vote on whether to abolish its monarchy, Prince Henry (Dennis Morgan) comes to New York City to observe ordinary life. Slipping away in disguise from his welcome party, the prince becomes friends with cab driver Buzz Williams (Jack Carson). After Buzz discovers the prince's identity, he lets his girlfriend, Connie (Joan Leslie), show the royal around the city. As the public wonders where the prince has disappeared to, he and Connie fall in love. (Comedy) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Desert Song
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A man leads a group of desert bandits against some Nazis, who want to use them as cheap labor for their railroad. (Musical) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Vengeance Valley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ten Tall Men
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sgt. Mike Kincaid is a rough-and-tumble French Foreign Legion leader who, while imprisoned in a stockade, overhears rumors of an enemy attack on his company's fort. Later, in between fighting amongst themselves over a beautiful French lady, Mike and his ragtag group of fighters improvise a plan to kidnap Mahla (Jody Lawrence), the daughter of a local sheik. actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
actionmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
actionmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eight

actionmax.us.title: Super Troopers 2

Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. moremax.us.title: The Alto Knights
moremax.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

moremax.us.title: The Art of Getting By
moremax.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Black Butterfly
moremax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

moremax.us.title: They All Laughed
moremax.us.description: The employees of New York City's Odyssey Detective Agency can't seem to prevent themselves from getting over-involved in their clients' lives. When aging gumshoe John Russo (Ben Gazzara) is assigned to trail an Italian millionaire's wife, Angela (Audrey Hepburn), he inevitably falls for her continental charm. His partner, Charles (John Ritter), is similarly unable to keep his hands off the woman he's trailing -- a winsome cheating spouse named Dolores (Dorothy Stratten). (Romantic comedy) - 1981

moremax.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
moremax.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
moremax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: MacGruber
moremax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Mojave
moremax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: Arctic
moremax.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Meg
moremax.us.description: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
moremax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Black Adam
moremax.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Atomic Blonde
moremax.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
moremax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Aftermath
moremax.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (Thriller, Drama, Action) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Mid90s
moremax.us.description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop. (Comedy drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Hoot
moremax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

moremax.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
moremax.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (Comedy drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Switch
moremax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Game Night
moremax.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Comedy, Action) - 2018

moremax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
moremax.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

moremax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
moremax.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: Scream

moremax.us.title: Us

moremax.us.title: The Nun

sbssydney.au.description: S5 E71 Episode 71 In this round, the specialty subjects are WWII Fighter Aces, The Inbetweeners, The Star Wars sequel trilogy (7.8.9), and Taskmaster UK: Series 12.

sbssydney.au.title: Big Fat Quiz: Best Bits
sbssydney.au.description: E1 Big Fat Quiz Best Bits: Ultimate Triumphs Victory is snatched from the jaws of humiliation as the country's funniest celebrities taste sweet success, in the finest cuts from The Big Fat Quiz.

sbssydney.au.title: 24 Hours In Emergency
sbssydney.au.description: S18 E5 About A Boy James has been rushed to Queen's Medical Centre after being struck in the eye with an arrow. Jim is in resus after crashing his car, and joiner Chris has a wound to his head after a work accident.

sbssydney.au.title: 8 Out Of 10 Cats Does Countdown
sbssydney.au.description: S14 E12 Episode 12 Lee Mack and Jason Manford take on Jon Richardson and Sarah Millican in the classic words and numbers quiz. While Nick Mohammed as Mr Swallow joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner.

sbssydney.au.title: Pandore
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E1 Episode 1 Claire, now a lawyer, is contacted by Alix Diaby, a young whistle-blower standing up against the Gai-App company, for which Krystel is a lobbyist.

sbssydney.au.title: Pandore
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E2 Episode 2 Alix and Claire prepare his defence. Helene asks Mark for a divorce and wants Claire to defend her. Mark's bill is rejected by the ministerial council for budgetary reasons.

sbssydney.au.title: Prisoner
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E5 Welcome Home, Soldier Youssef is in a coma, and Sammi feels he is put in a moral dilemma. If he comes clean about what happened, the officers gets what he deserves, but he'll be ostracized by all the other officers.

sbssydney.au.title: Prisoner
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 The House Always Wins The officers expect the worst in response to Youssef's death. The two rival gangs start talking to each other in the corners, and this is surely a bad sign.

sbssydney.au.title: Legacy List With Matt Paxton
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E7 Mom's Moving Story An only child has some tough decisions to make when they're forced to downsize the family home after their mom moves into a care facility. Emotions run high as they find cherished mementos.

sbssydney.au.title: Legacy List With Matt Paxton
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E8 No Country For Old Things A woman about to retire must clear out her entire house before moving to France. Matt helps with the downsize and keeps an eye out for a handful of items she won't leave home without.

sbssydney.au.title: Auction
sbssydney.au.description: S8 E12 Episode 12 During a New York heatwave, global bidders converge as Basquiat's works hit Christie's and Sotheby's. Sotheby's leads with 'Untitled', unseen for 30 years, poised to break records over $100 million.

sbssydney.au.title: Bamay

BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E15 The Visitation: Part 3 Nyssa and Adric and pursued by the Android, and they head to the safety of the TARDIS, while a mesmerised Tegan prepares to unleash the rats on the Doctor and Richard Mace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E16 The Visitation: Part 4 Heading to London Town, the Doctor discovers more Terileptil criminals in hiding. Forced to find a way to stop them, their soliton gas generator explodes, setting London ablaze.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E17 Black Orchid: Part 1 A murder is committed in Cranleigh Hall. The Cranleighs ask the Doctor to play cricket and then join them for a masked ball, enabling the killer to hide in plain sight.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E18 Black Orchid: Part 2 The Doctor stands accused, despite Lady Cranleigh knowing he is innocent. What is the secret she is protecting that allows her to let an honest man go to jail.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E19 Earthshock: Part 1 Deadly androids are protecting a bomb buried beneath the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E20 Earthshock: Part 2 With her crew slowly vanishing, Briggs assumes the Doctor to be the guilty party.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E21 Earthshock: Part 3 The Cybermen are released from their silos and are on the march.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E22 Earthshock: Part 4 The Doctor realises the freighter is now a huge bomb, with one passenger still aboard...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E23 Time-Flight: Part 1 When a Speedbird Concorde disappears back through a crack in time, the Doctor takes another Concorde to follow its trail, unaware that a mysterious conjuror, Kalid, waits for him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E24 Time-Flight: Part 2 After an encounter with the Plasmatons, Nyssa is possessed by strange aliens while the Doctor, joined by Professor Hayter investigates Kalid’s inner sanctum.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E25 Time-Flight: Part 3 From within their sarcophagus, the gestalt Xeraphin are communicating through Nyssa, but their psychic energy is so powerful, it may destroy her body completely.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E26 Time-Flight: Part 4 The Master’s TARDIS is repaired and the Doctor must follow him back to 20th century Heathrow, once he has rescued all the passengers and crew from both Concordes.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E1 Arc of Infinity: Part 1 On Gallifrey the Doctor has been chosen, during a clandestine meeting, to be used to perpetrate a terrible act. Unaware, the Doctor and Nyssa trace something odd to Amsterdam.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E2 Arc of Infinity: Part 2 Commander Maxil doesn’t believe the Doctor is innocent and reckons the easiest way to stop the evil being reborn on Gallifrey would be to kill him before the bonding can occur.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E3 Arc of Infinity: Part 3 President Borusa thinks the creature has been defeated but within the Matrix, the Doctor unmasks Omega and realises the threat to the matter universe is far from over.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E4 Arc of Infinity: Part 4 Omega has been reborn in Amsterdam in the Doctor's form, but the transference hasn’t worked. The Doctor pursues him through the city, aware Omega is now a walking anti-matter bomb.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E5 Snakedance: Part 1 The Mara is returning home, to the planet Manussa, five hundred years after being exiled. And it is using Tegan's subconscious to get there in the TARDIS.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E6 Snakedance: Part 2 As Tegan tries to rid her mind of the Mara forever, the Doctor learns about the Little Mind’s Eye crystal, while coping with the local politics of the Federator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E7 Snakedance: Part 3 As Tegan and Lon combine to give the Mara access back to reality, the Doctor locates the Great Mind’s Eye crystal but realises it is instrumental in the Mara's plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E8 Snakedance: Part 4 The Doctor and the original snakedancer Dojeen work to rid the planet of the malign Mara once and for all, but it has the whole of Manussa in its psychic grip now.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E9 Mawdryn Undead: Part 1 Caught in a warp ellipse, the TARDIS is drawn to a huge spacecraft orbiting Earth whereupon the Doctor is separated in space and time from Nyssa and Tegan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E2 The Leisure Hive: Part 2 The Tachyon Recreation Generator is the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive. Romana makes repairs, and the Doctor becomes a reluctant guinea pig.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E3 The Leisure Hive: Part 3 The Tachyon Generator has aged the Doctor into a white haired old man, but he discovers the truth behind the machine and uncovers a plot to take control of the Hive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E11 Mawdryn Undead: Part 3 Mawdryn and his eternal mutants are awake and reveal the truth, they are exiles, they are in pain and need something only the Doctor can give them. His future lives.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E12 Mawdryn Undead: Part 4 As the Doctor’s ethics are challenged and the two Brigadier's finally meet, Turlough plots with the Black Guardian to bring the Time Lord down once and for all.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E13 Terminus: Part 1 Turlough sabotages the TARDIS causing it to fuse with the space station Terminus. Trying to separate the two, the Doctor encounters a couple of space pirates.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E14 Terminus: Part 2 While the other Vanir sought out their hydromel, the curious Bor took a journey to try and solve the mystery at the heart of Terminus itself. And now he knows the secrets….

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E15 Terminus: Part 3 Trapped with the Lazars, Nyssa to find a way to help them, while the Doctor and Kari find the original pilot of Terminus and realise his mistake is about to be repeated...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E16 Terminus: Part 4 The Garm and the pirates stop Terminus setting off a second Big Bang, while the Vanir fight between themselves for their future. Meanwhile Nyssa makes a monumental decision...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E17 Enlightenment: Part 1 The TARDIS’s power is drained away just as the Doctor receives a dire warning from the White Guardian, and before long finds himself drawn into a strange race throgh the stars.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E18 Enlightenment: Part 2 While Tegan has to cope with the unwelcome attention of Marriner, the Doctor realises that Striker and his officers are Eternals and that the human crew mean nothing to them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E19 Enlightenment: Part 3 Captain Wrack manipulates Turlough, because she is also working for the Black Guardian and during an Eternals party she places a bomb aboard Striker’s ship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E20 Enlightenment: Part 4 The race for the Enlightenment is over and a winner has been crowned. But Turlough must make a decision and it’s one the Doctor and Tegan cannot help him with.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E21 The King's Demons: Part 1 At a medieval joust between Frenchman Sir Gilles and Hugh Fitzwilliam, the TARDIS appears. King John seems more curious than alarmed, as is Sir Gilles.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E22 The King's Demons: Part 2 The Master and the Doctor fight for control over Kamelion’s mind while Turlough and Tegan make new allies in the castle in an attempt to avoid the iron maiden.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: The Run Home with Joel and Fletch : Episode 84 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: E84 Joel and Fletch take a light-hearted look at the latest news in rugby league.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Superstars : Shane Webke ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: 2002 R4 BRI v CRO: An exclusive list of the biggest names in the game past and present, see their best games here.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: 90's Simply The Best : 1992 R22 Steelers v Broncos
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Tina said it best, take a look back at simply the best of the 1990s, the decade of expansion, fierce rivalries and the dominance of the Broncos and the Raiders.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Greatest Tests : 2015 PNG v FIJ
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: A selection of international clashes featuring memorable moments, great rivalries, inspirational performances and thrilling finishes.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: 2000's Greatest Games : 2003 R16 SOU v WAR
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: The 2000's brought a new era to the NRL, the debuts of some of the leagues biggest names and some of the best games in league history.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Face to Face on Fox : Brett Kenny Part 2
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: E19 Blues icon, Brett Kenny, speaks with Yvonne Sampson about winning his first Origin series, battles with Wally Lewis and possible Rugby League immortality.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: The Fan : Episode 14
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: E14 In this episode, Vossy visits a rugby league museum, Lara showcases a first in girls rugby league, Adam Reynolds takes the quiz & get to know Keano Kini.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Grand Final Classics : 2002 GF Roosters v Warriors
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Classic tries, heroic plays, first class performances. These are the games that created the legends.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Origin Classics : 1986 Game 3
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: S1 E30 State against State. Mate against Mate. FOX LEAGUE celebrates one of the fiercest rivalries in Australian sport with the greatest State of Origin matches ever played.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R14 Wests Tigers v Panthers
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Three SOO stars return for the competition leaders who have a four-point buffer, while the hosts' team includes a number of former Panthers GF winners.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R14 Sharks v Dragons
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: A local derby to conclude Sunday Ticket. The hosts in eighth entering Round 14 & their arch-rivals buoyed by a breakthrough win.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R14 Bulldogs v Eels
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Round 14 ends with a rivalry that dominated the 1980s. Plenty at stake in this King's Birthday clash as both sides try to keep in touch with the Top 8.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R15 Rabbitohs v Broncos
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Round 15 begins with the hosts clinging to eighth & the visitors desperate for victory to spark their title defence.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R15 Dolphins v Roosters
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: It's fifth against third in the only Friday Night Football game in Round 15.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R15 Warriors v Sharks
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: What a way to begin Super Saturday, a showdown between second & sixth.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R15 Eels v Raiders
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Raiders skipper Joseph Tapine will play his 250th NRL game. Josh Addo-Carr has three tries from his past three games against the Green Machine.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R15 Wests Tigers v Titans
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: This will be the final NRL game at Leichhardt Oval until 2028. The previous time they met at the famous venue, the hosts won by a point.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R16 Knights v Dragons
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Round 16 begins with sides resuming after the Bye. The hosts are in seventh & outclassed the visitors when they met in Round 10.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R16 Wests Tigers v Dolphins
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: The hosts bounced back to defeat the Titans last week, while the Dolphins are rolling along on a club-record six-game winning streak.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : R16 Titans v Panthers
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: In Round 22 last season, these sides were involved in one of the games of the year. The visitors won in golden point after blowing a 24-point lead.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRLW Mini : RND3 Broncos v Wests Tigers ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: A big test for Wests Tigers when they take on the Broncos in this clash between sides who have won their opening two games.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRLW Mini : RND3 Knights v Dragons ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: In Round 2, the Knights only lost by two against the powerful Roosters side, while the Dragons defeated the Eels after a dominant first half.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRLW : RND4 Raiders v Sharks
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: The Raiders suffered their first defeat in a thriller to the powerful Roosters, while the Sharks lost narrowly to the Bulldogs.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: 90's Simply The Best : 1993 R10 CBY v SOU ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Tina said it best, take a look back at simply the best of the 1990s, the decade of expansion, fierce rivalries and the dominance of the Broncos and the Raiders.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: 2000's Greatest Games : 2000 PF NEW v SYD ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: The 2000's brought a new era to the NRL, the debuts of some of the leagues biggest names and some of the best games in league history.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Face to Face on Fox : Ettingshausen Pt 1
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Sharks legend, Andrew Ettingshausen, speaks to Yvonne Sampson about his schoolboy debut, his rise at Cronulla and becoming the face of Rugby League.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: The Fan : Episode 15

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S16 E1 Episode 1 Celebrity guests Bez, Motsi Mabuse, Shazia Mirza and Steve Pemberton reveal extraordinary stories about themselves, but are they telling the truth or making it all up?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E24 Bullet Fired Vs. Bullet Dropped Adam and Jamie use gravity to test whether a bullet dropped from a height can catch up with one fired from a gun; experimenting to see whether it's possible to knock someone's socks off.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E7 Riccall In the north Yorkshire village of Riccall, Phil Spencer meets Lawrence and Catherine Bendelow, who are struggling to sell a house they've been renting out to tenants for four years.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E7 Mini Hgv Caravan And Railway Carriage Chris and Jodie transform a camper into a mini HGV-caravan, a couple revamps a railway carriage into a rustic retreat, and George and Will learn to photograph with a beer can.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E27 Episode 27 Yolanda Brown, Rev Kate Bottley, Joel Dommett and John Thomson test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E6 Kate Hiller-Heidke, Noah Szto, Denise Scott & Toshi Maeda Guests include Kate Miller-Heidke and as a result of her long name, I can't fit much else like Noah Szto, Denise Scott or Toshi Maeda. Oops, now I will really run out of room. Also Bill Shorten turns up in a new game tha.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E9 Radioactive Sandi Toksvig tunes in for a bit of 'Radio' activity, asking Alan Davies, Joe Lycett, Shazia Mirza and Josh Widdicombe some impossible and interesting questions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S19 E1 S19 Episode 1 Julie Hesmondhalgh, Chris McCausland, Yinka Bokinni & Harriet Kemsley Rob Brydon is back with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the lightning-quick team captains. Helping sort the fact from the fiction are guests Julie Hesmondhalgh, Chris McCausland, Yinka Bokinni and Harriet Kemsley.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Upper Middle Bogan
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E4 Sons of Anarchy Amber is appalled when Shawn invites his new and very alternative girlfriend to stay. Bess is upset when Edwina announces she wants to do medicine after meeting an inspirational surgeon, having never been inspired by Bess.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Upper Middle Bogan
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E5 Sticking to Your Principals Shawn drops out of school, so Amber turns to the school Principal who helps in an unexpected manner. Julie is injured so Kayne offers to drive for Team Wheeler, while Bess and Danny prepare Oscar for a wilderness expedition.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E11 You've Come A Long Way, Baby Holmes engages an old foe to protect his father after he learns Morland is in danger of being killed.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E14 Whose Appy Now Doug treats a dying 17-year-old cystic fibrosis patient who doesn't want to be resuscitated. Carter enjoys the task of removing Benton's appendix. Jeanie and Fischer share a kiss. Mark juggles not two girlfriends, but three.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E6 Whodunnit? Unable to convince Lucy that he didn't smash her precious heirloom, a blue and white antique vase that belonged to her grandmother, Lee summons the family to an emergency meeting to clear his name and flush out the culprit.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Rage Ausmusic Month Special ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E314 This November we're celebrating the best Australian music videos made right here in our own backyard. To do so, we asked some of our favourite artists to pick the home-grown tracks that they're digging right now.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E2 MI5 is under pressure to find another bomb and its maker in time to save a hospital from being destroyed.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E7 Riccall In the north Yorkshire village of Riccall, Phil Spencer meets Lawrence and Catherine Bendelow, who are struggling to sell a house they've been renting out to tenants for four years.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ)
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E6 Episode 6 Anika Moa, Bailey Poching, Mike Minogue and the Episode Five champ face Guy's wordy chaos in O! What a Knight, For Whom the Spell Tolls and Do the D.A.N.C.E.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E9 Quiet Sandi Toksvig calls for a bit of 'Quiet', this time inviting Andrew Maxwell, Sara Pascoe and Jimmy Carr to join regular panellist Alan Davies to face her fiendish posers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E1 Gardens Award-winning host Stephen Fry wrangles a stellar panel of comedians in the world's most impossible quiz show. This episode features Alan Davies, Dara O'Briain, Rob Brydon and David Mitchell.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E10 To Cut a Woman's Hair Jake is in trouble, he needs Finn to find a princess who would be willing to give up a lock of their hair to save him from a balding witch.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E21 Sheep Bears The Bears get jobs as sheep herders on an idyllic farm.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E41 The Bergerac The Titans give Robin advice to guide him through his camp romance with Wonder Girl.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E3 Worship After being blasted by Duplikate, Blossom turns into a triple threat.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E17 Frozer A figure skating trainer named Philippe gets akumatized into Frozer. Armed with evil ice skates, he wants to turn Paris into a Kingdom of Ice. Ladybug and Cat Noir can't get cold feet if they want to stop him!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E8 The Ward Matron arrives with Nancy, her young ward. Gwen tells Nancy to ask Matron to stay, then Nancy joins the Third searching for the missing time capsule.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 K-Crushed Hannah must write a song with Chan-Mi, but is surprised to discover Chan-Mi and Supreme are secretly dating by spotting similarities in their lyrics. Leo meets DJ, the Level One dance instructor, and shadows her dance class.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 The Walk-a-thon The children face the difficult task of finding the right partner to be their walking buddy for the walk-a-thon. Tamara is determined to find the best companion who will assist her in doing the most laps.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E28 Seeing Is Believing! Jessie of Team Rocket is sure her Pokemon will evolve into a lovely Beautifly someday, but she could be in for a rude awakening!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E2 In Ruins Mo and Thrash discover ancient ruins where an alien lay in stasis. When it awakens and follows them home, they realize it has a plan of its own.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E15 Sons of Mars A case of Martian mistaken identity comes to Ooo when Magic Man turns Jake into a copy of himself.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E40 Throne of Bones Robin warns of dangers of heavy metal music.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E43 BBRAEBDAY Raven's demon side has the same birthday as Beast Boy, so the Titans go to Azarath to celebrate her Sinister Sixteen.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E30 The Heist / The Petals / The Nuisance / The Best / The Worst / The List / The Deal / The Line Richard discovers going into a bank whilst wearing a motorcycle helmet can land you in a lot of trouble.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E3 Barb and the Spotted Bears Chapter 3: Nightcap Barb and the elves band together to protect the source of all magic from a pair of fiendish intruders. But will Barb be able to outsmart two rascals as old as the world itself?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E7 King Pong Jim and Bianca are convinced they're the best ping-pong players on the sub and organize a tournament. But despite practicing every day, they come dead last. What's the deal?! And what can they do to win?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E24 Bananas & Cheese Duncan is determined to stop the musical duo Bananas & Cheese from coming to the daycare.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Adventures With Superman
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 My Interview With Superman Lois wants to interview Superman for The Daily Planet, and Clark must figure out how to help her while protecting his secret identity! Meanwhile, criminal ring Intergang gets their hands on unstable weapons.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ninjago
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Can of Worms Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Learn A Word
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 Two Learn to spell and write the word Two. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Alphablocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E8 Treasure Searching for treasure, the Alphablocks ride towards a BIG tree on the back of a PIG. They feed it a FIG and accidentally make it a WIG. At the tree they DIG up something unusual.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 Shades of the Forest Green is surprised when Black and White arrive in her forest. Learn about light and dark colours with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E19 I'll Vote for That! The Numberblocks have so many fun ideas for what to play, that it's hard to choose what to do next! Ten suggests they all vote. But what is a vote?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E23 Babracadabra! When Mr. More borrows Princess Presto's wand for his magic show, things go bananas!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Clocks Maddie heads to a clock factory and uses a special time-lapse camera to show how the hands on the clock move around.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E19 Get To Know Your Roots Sick plants? Could be the roots! Dr Tammy to the rescue. Tammy analyses two plants and helps Romeo and Harper repot them for plant happiness. From root rot to pot pound, the team have it covered!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Blood Dr Chris and Dr Xand break down blood and show how to build a blood lava lamp in today's DO try this at home experiment.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Horrible Science ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E11 Mars – The Musical, the Clean Power Rangers and Silent but Deadly 60 The Clean Power Rangers save the day, Dr Big Brain wants a lair on the moon, Steve Backfire searches for the Silent but Deadly 60, and we bring you Mars – The Musical.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Built to Survive
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Desert Dwellers In the endless heat of the sands near Munga Thirri, (The Simpson Desert), Phil encounters Australia's largest lizard - the perentie, our fastest flightless bird - the emu, and the world's largest marsupial - the red kangaroo.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ages Of Ice Portrait of a Scientist Shorts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Ian Kelly Geophysicist As the young geophysicist embarks on his first expedition to Antarctica, Ian Kelly discovers that beyond the science lies something even more powerful: a landscape of breathtaking scale.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E200 Episode 200 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E7 Mini Hgv Caravan And Railway Carriage Chris and Jodie transform a camper into a mini HGV-caravan, a couple revamps a railway carriage into a rustic retreat, and George and Will learn to photograph with a beer can.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E7 Builder Lucy takes the kids away to her parents while Lee stays home to oversee the building work in their kitchen. Unfortunately, the lazy builder forces Lee to confront his fear of confrontation - by avoiding it at all costs.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E3 The MI5 team infiltrate a far right political party and Adam and Ruth become the targets of a racist.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E11 You've Come a Long Way, Baby Holmes engages an old foe to protect his father after he learns Morland is in danger of being killed.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E13 Infantile This episode of QI is going to be pretty infantile, with Dave Gorman, Ronni Ancona, Lee Mack and Alan Davies.

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

wncf.us.description: Emmy-winning funnyman Jimmy Kimmel serves up comedy bits and welcomes guests that include other comics, celebrities, athletes and musicians, as well as everyday people with unusual or compelling personal stories. Kimmel's family and friends take part in the festivities, including his Cousin Sal, Uncle Frank (until his death in 2011) and childhood friend Cleto Escobedo III, who leads the show's house band.
