fxm.us.title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
fxm.us.description: Down on their luck and out of cash, high-speed racer Larry (Peter Fonda) and his repairman (Adam Roarke) plan to hold up a supermarket that's fat with a fresh payroll. Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller. (Action) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Soup to Nuts
fxm.us.description: Two guys and a girl run into Mexican rebels and lots of fires. (Comedy) - 1930

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: The Black Rose
fxm.us.description: Following the 13th-century death of his nobleman father, Walter of Gurnie (Tyrone Power) and his confidant, Tristram (Jack Hawkins), join a caravan led by the North African Bayan (Orson Welles) en route to China. Along the way, the beautiful Maryam (Cecile Aubry), known as the Black Rose, begs Walter to take her to England with him. When the warlord Bayan reveals his intention to invade and subjugate China's advanced society, the trio attempt their escape back to England. (Adventure) - 1950

fxm.us.title: All About Eve
fxm.us.description: Backstage story revolving around aspiring actress Eve Harrington. Tattered and forlorn, Eve shows up in the dressing room of Broadway mega-star Margo Channing, telling a melancholy life story to Margo and her friends. Margo takes Eve under her wing, and it appears that Eve is a conniver that uses Margo. (Drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: My Friend Flicka
fxm.us.description: Ken McLaughlin (Roddy McDowall) is a precocious 10-year-old who lives with his family on a remote Wyoming ranch. When Ken returns home from school with failing grades, his father, Rob (Preston Foster), blames the boy's lack of personal responsibility. At the suggestion of his wife, Nell (Rita Johnson), Rob allows Ken to choose a single colt from the herd to raise as his own. Much to his father's dismay, Ken chooses a fiery mustang filly -- but the two soon become fast friends. (Children, Drama) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Curly Top
fxm.us.description: Charming, headstrong young Elizabeth Blair (Shirley Temple) lives at the Lakeside Orphanage where her sister, Mary (Rochelle Hudson), works in the kitchen. Mary writes songs that Elizabeth sings. The child's performance and her spirit impress a young, wealthy trustee, Edward Morgan (John Boles), who poses as a lawyer with an offer of adoption for Elizabeth, but she won't leave without her sister. Edward decides to bring them both to his mansion, and soon begins to fall in love with Mary. (Musical) - 1935

fxm.us.title: A Journal for Jordan
fxm.us.description: Deployed to Iraq, First Sgt. Charles Monroe King starts to keep a journal of love and advice for his infant son. Back at home, Dana Canedy, a senior editor for The New York Times, revisits the story of her unlikely, life-altering relationship with King and his enduring devotion to his beloved family. (Drama, Romance) - 2021

While working at his new, prestigious post, Sinuhe suffers through a botched romance and the death of his adoptive parents. Despondent, he leaves the Pharaoh's court to bury his loved ones, and, in the process, incurs the wrath of Akhnaton. (Historical drama) - 1954

365blk.us.title: Push: Based on the Novel by Sapphire
365blk.us.description: Pregnant by her own father for the second time, 16-year-old Claireece "Precious" Jones (Gabourey Sidibe) can neither read nor write and suffers constant abuse at the hands of her vicious mother (Mo'Nique). Precious instinctively sees a chance to turn her life around when she is offered the opportunity to transfer to an alternative school. Under the patient, firm guidance of her new teacher, Ms. Rain (Paula Patton), Precious begins the journey from oppression to self-determination. (Drama) - 2009

365blk.us.title: Gods of Egypt

Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation. (Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2016

With nowhere else to turn, Dr. Napier enlists maverick ex-teacher Joe Clark (Morgan Freeman) to take over as principal of the declining school. Unfortunately for Clark, before he can focus on improving the student body's state exam scores, he has to somehow rid the school of its gang and narcotics problems. (Biography, Drama) - 1989

365blk.us.description: After leaving the South as a young man and finding employment at an elite hotel in Washington, D.C., Cecil Gaines (Forest Whitaker) gets the opportunity of a lifetime when he is hired as a butler at the White House. Over the course of three decades, Cecil has a front-row seat to history and the inner workings of the Oval Office. However, his commitment to his "First Family" leads to tension at home, alienating his wife (Oprah Winfrey) and causing conflict with his anti-establishment son. (Historical drama) - 2013

Jack sees a way to redeem his wasted life by protecting the affable Eddie from the would-be assassins. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2006

(Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2022

365blk.us.description: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again. 5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Walkabout
5starmax.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Head Office
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Hop
5starmax.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Animated) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Holla
5starmax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Horror) - 2006

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Blood Simple
5starmax.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
5starmax.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 1963

5starmax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
5starmax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
5starmax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
5starmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
5starmax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Odd Jobs
5starmax.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
5starmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

Dubbing themselves the Wolverines, the youths launch guerrilla attacks against the invaders, but how long they can sustain the fight in the face of the enemy's superior numbers and firepower remains in question. (Action, Adventure) - 2012

bbcamerica.us.title: The Hunt for Red October
bbcamerica.us.description: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. (Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Heartbreak Ridge
bbcamerica.us.description: Marine Sgt. Thomas Highway (Clint Eastwood) is a decorated veteran of two wars. On his last posting before retirement, he is surrounded by officers with no combat experience who view him as an odd, even dangerous, holdover. Highway is assigned to train a group of undisciplined recruits including Cpl. Stitch Jones (Mario Van Peebles), a slick hustler who has previously encountered Highway. As the old soldier prepares his men for a war they don't believe will come, the U.S. invades Grenada. (War, Comedy drama, Action) - 1986

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinevault.us.title: White Boy Rick
cinevault.us.description: Rick Wershe is a single father who's struggling to raise two teenagers during the height of the crack epidemic in the 1980s Detroit. Wershe sells guns illegally to make ends meet but soon attracts attention from the FBI. Federal agents convince his son, Rick Jr., to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself. (Biography, Crime drama, Movie) - 2018-08-31

cinevault.us.title: Bad Country
cinevault.us.description: After arresting a contract killer, a Louisiana detective tries to convince him to become an informant in an attempt to bring down the South's most powerful criminal organization. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014

cinevault.us.title: Against All Odds
cinevault.us.description: Having been cut from his professional football team, down-and-out athlete Terry Brogan (Jeff Bridges) is in desperate need of money. Crooked nightclub owner and bookie Jake Wise (James Woods) offers Terry a hefty sum to go to Mexico and find his girlfriend, Jessie Wyler (Rachel Ward). Terry cannot turn the offer down. When Terry locates Jessie, the two fall in love. Terry reports that he failed to find her; but Jake sends someone else. Terry and Jessie's love must endure unexpected twists. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Romance) - 1984-03-02

cinevault.us.title: Sahara
cinevault.us.description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole. (Movie, War) - 1995-04-25

cinevault.us.title: Bermuda Triangle
cinevault.us.description: A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle. (Drama, Movie) - 1996-04-04

cinevault.us.title: The Last Dragonslayer
cinevault.us.description: A young orphan girl (Ellise Chappell), indentured servant to a magician, discovers that she's destined to become the last dragonslayer in a world with only one remaining dragon. (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2016-12-25

cinevault.us.title: Facing the Giants
cinevault.us.description: Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams. (Action, Drama, Movie) - 2006-09-29

cinevault.us.title: Wild America
cinevault.us.description: The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1997-07-02

cinevault.us.title: Places in the Heart
cinevault.us.description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton. (Drama, Movie) - 1984-09-21

cinevault.us.title: Eat Pray Love
cinevault.us.description: Liz Gilbert (Julia Roberts) thought she had everything she wanted in life: a home, a husband and a successful career. Now newly divorced and facing a turning point, she finds that she is confused about what is important to her. Daring to step out of her comfort zone, Liz embarks on a quest of self-discovery that takes her to Italy, India and Bali. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2010-08-13

cinevault.us.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
cinevault.us.description: Adaptation of Bram Stoker's classic vampire novel. Gary Oldman plays Dracula whose lonely soul is determined to reunite with his lost love, Mina. In Britain, Dracula begins a reign of terror and seduction draining the life from her closest friend, Lucy. Together they try and drive Dracula away. (Horror, Movie) - 1992-11-13

cinevault.us.title: Darkness Falls
cinevault.us.description: In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-01-24

cinevault.us.title: Blue-Eyed Butcher
cinevault.us.description: Susan Wright (Sara Paxton) stands trial for the murder of her husband (Justin Bruening) in their Texas home. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2012-03-03

cinevault.us.title: Little Nikita
cinevault.us.description: Roy Parmenter is an FBI agent with a long-standing vendetta against a Russian spy named Scuba. Now, Scuba is blackmailing the Soviet government by tracking down and assassinating their sleeper agents in the United States. Parmenter discovers that high-school student Jeff Grant is the son of two such agents, which is a total shock to Jeff. Parmenter must try to track Scuba while also protecting the Grants. (Movie, Thriller) - 1988-06-25

cinevault.us.title: Crooked House
cinevault.us.description: Someone poisons the patriarch of the wealthy Leonides family, leading to an investigation. (Crime drama, Movie, Mystery) - 2017-12-17

cinevault.us.title: Mary Reilly
cinevault.us.description: A maid at the household of noted physician Dr. Henry Jekyll (John Malkovich), Mary Reilly (Julia Roberts) admires her employer, who also seems intrigued by her. Eventually, Mary meets Jekyll's mysterious and charismatic associate, Edward Hyde (also Malkovich), and she also seems to have an attraction to him. As Mary spends time with both men, she starts to suspect there is a strange connection between the two of them, and this revelation places her life in danger. (Drama, Movie) - 1996-06-08

cinevault.us.title: The Lazarus Project
cinevault.us.description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-10-21

cinevault.us.title: Dirty
cinevault.us.description: Armando Sancho is a former Los Angeles gang member who has transitioned into law enforcement. Sancho, however, who is surrounded by corruption, finds that life as a police officer is just as morally bankrupt as life as a gangster. After being implicated in the shooting of an innocent man himself, Sancho is then pressured to testify against his loose-cannon friend and partner, Salim Adel, who has a history of abusing citizens. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-11-09

cinevault.us.title: Hardwired
cinevault.us.description: After surviving a car crash that kills his pregnant wife, Luke Gibson (Cuba Gooding Jr.) wakes up in the hospital with complete amnesia. He's been severely injured, but is alive thanks to a groundbreaking brain implant from a powerful multinational corporation. As Luke recovers, he starts to realize his implant is dangerous and seeks help from Hal (Michael Ironside), the leader of a group of hackers. A shadowy executive (Val Kilmer) tries to stop Luke and Hal before they learn too much. (Action, Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2009-11-03

cinevault.us.title: Red Water
cinevault.us.description: Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water. (Movie, Thriller) - 2003-08-17

circlecountry.us.title: Red Headed Stranger

After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again. (Western) - 1986

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E10 Iwan Thomas accepts a stunt challenge from precision driver Russ Swift; Jonny Smith secretly repairs potholes; Tom Ford drives a Monster.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E01 Vicki tests two cars, the Lotus Exige S vs. Caterham CSR; Tom visits Spain to drive the Toyota Land Cruiser; Jason Plato drives the Mercedes CLK63 Black; Tiff teaches Heston Blumenthal the art of power sliding.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E02 Tom gets an advance look at Formula 1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone's rare and unusual collection of cars; Tiff and Jason take the BMW M3 and the Mercedes C63 AMG to a circuit to determine which is most deserving of its £50,000 price tag.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E04 Vicki tests the Mercedes Vito X or the VW Transporter Sportline on the track to find out which is quickest; Jonny embarks on the 600-mile transcontinental trip in the BMW 635d; Tom drives the ultimate 4x4, the 12-ton, 10-foot tall Unimog.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is the fastest, the Renault Twingo GT or the Fiat Panda 100HP; Tiff Needell and Jason Plato go head-to-head; this time it's small coupes as the Porsche Cayman comes up against the new BMW 135i Coupe.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson is at Anglesey for another shoot-out; his time it's super chic superminis, the BMW Mini One against the Fiat 500; Jason Plato delivers his verdict on the Nissan Skyline now re-badged as the GT-R.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E07 Vicki is at the controls in a classic Ford v Vauxhall battle, two boy racer specials, the Fiesta ST and Corsa SRi, wage war to find out which is fastest; Tom journeys to the Arctic Circle to test the Volvo XC70, an estate car with four-wheel drive.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Anglesey for another Fifth Gear shoot-out. This week it's the Porsche Cayenne GTS against the BMW X5. Tom Ford drives the new C5 and Tiff Needell tests the new Subaru Impreza STi.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is quickest, the VW Golf GTI or Subaru Impreza WRX; Jonny Smith proves there are still some cars that you can buy for under $1,500.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E10 Vicki takes the Focus RS and the Escort Cosworth to find out once and for all which handles best around a track; Jason drives the Grand Tourer and delivers his verdict whether the £78,000 asking price would represent money well spent.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E01 Tim Shaw joins the team, and he's been specially tasked with standing up for the beleaguered motorist; Jason Plato and Tiff Needell go head-to-head on the track to find out which car is fastest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E02 Tiff Needell takes two coupes onto the Fifth Gear track, the Mazda RX8 and Nissan 350Z; Vicki Butler-Henderson spends a day with Formula One star Lewis Hamilton; Tom Ford is the lucky man behind the wheel of the facelifted Mercedes SL63 AMG.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E03 Jason Plato races two estates head to head; Vicki Butler-Henderson pits the new Pro-Ceed against the VW Golf; Jonny Smith picks up an amazing luxury car for £1000 or less; Tiff Needell runs the most exciting car vs. bike race to date.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E04 Jason Plato pitches a lunatic Honda Civic Mugen RR imported from Japan against a Honda S2000 sports car from the UK; Jonny Smith tests the VW Passat CC v Mercedes CLS; Tiff Needell takes to the track to test the brand new KTM X-Bow.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tiff and Jason race two V8 mega-saloons. Tom has the only television test of the Dodge Challenger.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E06 Tim Shaw tests whether manufacturers' claimed 0-62mph acceleration times are actually true or not; Vicki Butler-Henderson heads out to the track in two Porsches.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E07 Tom Ford tests the brand new Ford Fiesta; Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell challenge each other on two wheels; Jonny shows us three great cars we could all suddenly afford to buy if we were to all stop drinking.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

filmriseaction.us.title: Cover-Up
filmriseaction.us.description: An American journalist (Dolph Lundgren) gets too close to the truth about alleged terrorist attacks in Tel Aviv. (Action) - 1991

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 1999

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery. (Comedy, Crime drama, Action) - 2008

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone
filmriseaction.us.description: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist. (Historical drama) - 1995

filmriseaction.us.title: Guns of Redemption
filmriseaction.us.description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel. (Western, Action) - 2025

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. (Western) - 2023

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz
filmriseaction.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State
filmriseaction.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Survivor
filmriseaction.us.description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. (Drama) - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: The Final Stand
filmriseaction.us.description: The story of the Podolsk cadets in October 1941 near Moscow during WWII, where the cadets of the Podolsk artillery-infantry schools receive orders to take up defenses on the Ilyinsky line. (Action, Drama, War) - 2020

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2001

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E06 The Family Way Martin is surprised and puzzled when his parents suddenly arrive for a visit; Martin's examination of a woman leads to a surprise diagnosis.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E01 The Apple Doesn't Fall A new police officer, who has narcolepsy, replaces Mark Mylow; Martin treats a girl who's been taking her mother's diet pills.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E04 The Admirer Louisa Glasson finds out she has a rival for Doc Martin's affections; Martin accidentally runs over a dog.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E05 The Holly Bears a Prickle Louisa ends her relationship with Martin, but when she needs him to treat her injured friend, he gets a chance to redeem himself.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E06 Nowt So Queer Portwenn is buzzing with news; Bert's restaurant is in trouble, so his son decides to take action to save the business.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E07 Happily Ever After Martin needs to find a replacement vicar just three hours before the wedding; bridesmaid Isobel goes into labor.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E01 Better the Devil Martin prepares to leave Portwenn when his relationship with Louisa fails; Martin's medical school girlfriend arrives.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E02 Uneasy Lies the Head Martin is unsure what to do when he hears Louisa's news, but Louisa does not want him involved; Louisa's new headmaster is exhibiting erratic behavior.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E05 The Departed The widow of one of Doc's patients believes her husband is trying to communicate from the grave; one of Louisa's students falls ill on a class trip.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E08 The Wrong Goodbye Bert has another money-making scheme go wrong on Doc's last day in Portwenn, causing Louisa to go into premature labor.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E01 Preserve the Romance Martin Ellingham's plans to resume his career are put on hold with the birth of a baby; the new GP misdiagnoses a patient.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E03 Born With a Shotgun Martin's new receptionist makes a poor first impression; Louisa and Martin find sleepless nights are taking their toll.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E05 Remember Me Joe Penhale's amnesiac ex-wife visits; Louisa's mother may find romance; Martin and Louisa still need to name their baby.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E06 Don't Let Go Joe Penhale is desperate to show Maggie he has changed; Martin has to rescue Mr. Coley from a rooftop.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E07 Cats and Sharks Bert Large's restaurant is in financial trouble, and he is unable to help with the charity event for Florence Dingle's cat sanctuary.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E02 Guess Who's Coming to Dinner? Martin has second thoughts about their nanny, who is constantly scratching; the nanny walks out; Penhale calls into a radio show to learn how to win friends.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E03 The Tameness of a Wolf Ruth has a mystery admirer who unnerves her; Louisa gets in trouble with Bert when one of her students writes about getting food poisoning at his restaurant.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E04 Nobody Likes Me Martin takes baby James to playgroup, where he is forced to sing along with the other moms; Al signs up for a dating website; Bert finds Jennifer in the bathroom with a needle.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E05 The Practice Around the Corner Mrs. Tishell returns to the village; Martin has to work out what is wrong with beachcomber Lorna; Al and Morwenna have Internet dating disasters.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E06 Hazardous Exposure Martin's mother returns to Portwenn; questions about asbestos cause panic; Bert has a question for Jennifer.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E07 Listen With Mother Martin helps Louisa hand out awards at school; showdown between Ruth and Margaret; Mike has a shady revelation from his past.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E08 Departure Louisa has news for Martin; disaster hits at Bert and Jennifer's engagement party; Al has a business proposition for Ruth.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E01 Going Bodmin Martin's first patient is a man who has grown breasts; Martin is forced off the road on his way out of the village.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E02 Gentlemen Prefer Though Martin has opened his surgery, his patients seem to treat it more as a social hangout; Martin is forced to fire Elaine for incompetence.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E03 S... Happens When a nasty stomach bug sweeps through Portwenn, Martin takes to the radio to alert residents to the danger, with unforeseen consequences.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Bone Snatcher
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A scientist (Scott Bairstow) finds a monster that devours its prey in the deserts of South Africa. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blitz
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. (Thriller) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Kill Switch
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tenn., by murdering young women, and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings. (Action, Thriller) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Killing Season
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A U.S. veteran (Robert De Niro) and a former Serbian soldier (John Travolta) play cat-and-mouse games in the remote wilderness. (Thriller, Action) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The 51st State
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob. (Crime drama) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond. (Drama, Fantasy, War) - 1999

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (Historical drama) - 1990

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Intoxicated

retroplex.us.title: Pioneer Justice
retroplex.us.description: Something strange is going on in the frontier town of Buffalo Gap. After two men turn up dead, a marshal named Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) arrives, along with his partner, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), to investigate. Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: The Tioga Kid
retroplex.us.description: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Check Your Guns
retroplex.us.description: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad). (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: West of the Divide
retroplex.us.description: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Bells of Coronado
retroplex.us.description: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers. (Western) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
retroplex.us.description: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: In Old Amarillo
retroplex.us.description: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought. (Western) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: The Lucky Texan
retroplex.us.description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Oath of Vengeance

Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
retroplex.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) saves noted Swiss physicist Franz Tobel (William Post Jr.) from the Gestapo in Zurich and smuggles him to London. There, Tobel is reunited with his wife, Charlotte (Kaaren Verne), to whom he gives a coded message in the event he disappears. Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty (Lionel Atwill), Holmes and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) risk their lives to find him. (Mystery) - 1942

retroplex.us.title: Dressed to Kill

retroplex.us.title: The Woman in Green

classica.us.description: (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-02-02

classica.us.title: Arien, Soli und Duette von J. S. Bach
classica.us.description: Bariton Matthias Goerne, Violinist Vilde Frang, Cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, Flötist Stathis Karapanos und Cembalistin Michaela Hasselt widmen sich der Musik von J. S. Bach. Dieses Konzert wurde in der Marienkirche in Wittenberg aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-04-14

classica.us.title: Janáčeks Violinsonate
classica.us.description: Martha Argerich spielt in diesem Konzert die Violinsonate des Tschechen Leoš Janáček. Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin bei diesem Konzert im Château de Chantilly dem Kammermusikrepertoire. (Special, Music, Event) - 2025-06-03

classica.us.title: Hans van Manen: Moving to Music
classica.us.description: Reflexionen von Freunden und Kollegen, die Details der Choreographie von Hans van Manen enthüllen. (Special, Documentary, Dance, Ballet)

classica.us.title: Liszt - Zwei sinfonische Dichtungen
classica.us.description: Franz Liszt verfasste 13 sinfonische Dichtungen, die von literarischen Texten inspiriert waren. Der Komponist schrieb Klavier-Duette für diese Dichtungen, die sein beeindruckendes Talent zeigten, ein volles Orchester mit nur einem Piano zu imitieren. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-15

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 9. Sinfonie, Op. 125
classica.us.description: Sir Simon Rattle präsentiert Beethovens neunte Symphonie. Die Solisten sind Iwona Sobotka, Anna Stephany, Robert Murray und Florian Boesch. Mit unvergleichlicher symphonischer Finesse komponierte Beethoven seine neunte Symphonie. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-09-06

classica.us.title: Kammermusik von Haydn, Chausson & Mendelssohn
classica.us.description: Junge Musiker der Hochschule für Musik Reina Sofía präsentieren Werke von Joseph Haydn, Ernest Chausson und Felix Mendelssohn. Diese Aufführung wurde am 7. Juni 2024 im Auditorio Sony der Hochschule in Madrid, Spanien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music) - 2025-12-02

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Zubin Mehta
classica.us.description: Der indische Dirigent Zubin Mehta wurde 1977 Musikdirektor des Israel Philharmonic Orchestra und 1981 zum Musikdirektor auf Lebenszeit ernannt. Als einer der weltweit führenden Interpreten der großen symphonischen Literatur hat Mehta dieses beliebte Meisterwerk unzählige Male dirigiert, aber es war das erste Mal, dass er es von Grund auf einstudiert hat. Ein intimer Blick wird auf den Dialog zwischen Mehta und den Mitgliedern des Orchesters geworfen, während sie Strauss' Tondichtung proben. (Music) - 2000-04-02

classica.us.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 34, K. 338
classica.us.description: Der Maestro Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem fesselnden Konzertprogramm mit Werken von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Antonín Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur. (Special, Event) - 2025-06-04

classica.us.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 6 a-Moll
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahler (1860-1911): Symphonie Nr. 6 a-Moll. Paavo Järvi dirigiert das hr-Sinfonieorchester. Aufgenommen beim Rheingau Musik Festival im Kloster Eberbach. Der österreichische Komponist und Dirigent Gustav Mahler führte die traditionsreiche Gattung der Symphonie ins 20. Jahrhundert. Seine Werke sind heute Bestandteil des Standardrepertoires jedes großen Orchesters. (Special, Music, Event) - 2015-08-26

classica.us.title: Mahler - 8. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Fabio Luisi dirigiert das Dänische Sinfonieorchester in einem Konzert von Mahlers 8. Sinfonie. Diese Performance wurde 2017 im dänischen "DR Koncerthuset" in Kopenhagen aufgenommen. (Music, Concert) - 2023-03-22

classica.us.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
classica.us.description: Die von Carl Orff komponierten „Carmina Burana" sind in den Jahren 1935 und 1936 entstanden. Die Kantate basiert auf 24 Gedichten aus der gleichnamigen mittelalterlichen Sammlung, bestehend aus zumeist lateinischen Lied- und Dramentexten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-01-01

classica.us.title: Chopin - Fantaisie in f-Moll, op. 49
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Molteni führt Frédéric Chopins Fantaisie in f-Moll, Op. 49, auf. Molteni begann im Alter von sechs Jahren mit dem Klavierspiel. Er absolvierte das Conservatorio di Musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como mit Auszeichnung. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-05-10

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - Sinfonie Nr. 2, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Sir John Eliot Gardiner leitet das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem Konzertprogramm, das Pjotr Iljitsch Tschaikowskys Symphonie Nr. 2 in c-Moll, op. 17, "Kleiner Russe", enthält. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Mahlers 9. Symphonie besticht durch ihre tiefgreifende emotionale Tiefe und Verletzlichkeit, insbesondere durch das atemberaubend schöne und spirituell nachhallende Adagio. (Special) - 2026-04-11

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 1
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-04

classica.us.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchestra und den Chor in einem Konzert mit Werken von Richard Strauss, Metamorphosen, und Mozarts Requiem. Die Solisten sind Siobhan Stagg, Avery Amereau, Ben Bliss und Anthony Robin Schneider. Aufgenommen wurde dies in der Severance Hall, Cleveland im März 2023. (Special, Music) - 2023-01-01

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - 4. Sinfonie in c-Moll, Op. 43
classica.us.description: Das Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra spielt die Stücke von Dimitri Schostakowitsch nach und verzaubert damit die Zuhörer. Als Dirigent entpuppt sich Yannick Nézet-Séguin, welcher seit knapp zwölf Jahren das Orchester leitet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-05-02

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Concertino für zwei Klaviere
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Repertoire für Klavier und Violine in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgezeichnet wurde. (Special, Music) - 2025-05-31

moviesphere.us.title: The Great Debaters
moviesphere.us.description: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions. moviesphere.us.title: Fruitvale Station

paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened.
