tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 Luxury Staycation Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E02 Property Brothers: Dorothy and John Busy parents Dorothy and John have been crashing in his parents' basement, and with baby number two on the way they're desperate to find a home of their own. It's a race against time, and the Property Brothers step in with a plan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E20 Property Brothers: Katie & Michael Confined to a tiny home in a hot neighborhood, Katie, Michael, and their three daughters quickly sold their property. But now they're squeezed into a one-bedroom rental until the Property Brothers can find them their forever home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E15 Property Brothers - Amanda & Tre Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E24 Property Brothers: Carson & Leah Super-planner Carson has been crashing at her best friend Leah's place. But it's time she found a Nashville pad of her own. Carson knows exactly what she wants, but finding a picture-perfect property that meets her high standards could prove tricky.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E04 Property Brothers: Kevin and Shirley Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E10 Property Brothers: Sandi & Phil Sandi and Phil have lived in their park-filled waterfront neighborhood for years. But with the arrival of their baby boy, they've suddenly outgrown their one-room loft-style apartment, and are searching for an allergy-free forever home.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
tastemadetravel.us.description: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Desperately Seeking Santa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games. (Cooking, Travel) - 2025-09-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels - Invisible Hideaways

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Betty Lou Had A Great Fall, Gurdon Ghost Light and Twitch And Shout

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Lost City of the Monkey God, Christmas Tree for Teddy and Bell Island Boom

travel.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Dickens to the Rescue, Check Off to Take Off and Waterlogged Whiskers
travel.us.description: Don Wildman investigates beloved British author Charles Dickens' heroics in the face of a real-life cliffhanger, a plane crash that forever changed aviation safety and the clever cup that saved a popular facial hair fad. (Travel, Documentary)

truehistory.us.title: World War I: The "Great War" - Towards Crisis in Politics and Culture
truehistory.us.description: Even among those who expect war, there are widespread misconceptions about the nature of the conflict to come; in this lecture, exploring the prevailing ideas and attitudes in Europe; the premonitions noted by contemporaries of coming disaster. (World history) - 2006-02-27

truehistory.us.title: World War I: The "Great War" - Causes of the War and the July Crisis, 1914
truehistory.us.description: This lecture analyzes the immediate events that lead to war; the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary at Sarajevo in June 1914; the diplomatic chain reactions that follow in the July Crisis. (World history) - 2006-02-27

truehistory.us.title: World War I: The "Great War" - The August Madness
truehistory.us.description: The hysterical celebration known as the August Madness greets the outbreak of war between the Central Powers (Germany and Austria-Hungary) and the Allies (France, Great Britain and Russia); how widespread this emotional outburst really is. (World history) - 2006-02-27

truehistory.us.title: World War I: The "Great War" - The Failed Gambles - War Plans Break Down
truehistory.us.description: This lecture follows the unfolding of the German Schlieffen Plan, which envisions quick victory on two fronts; the French Plan XVII aims to recover lost French territories; both attempts are thwarted. (World history) - 2006-02-27

truehistory.us.title: World War I: The "Great War" - The Western Front Experience
truehistory.us.description: The Western Front soon freezes into static trench warfare and horrific slaughter from attempts to break this deadlock; generals on both sides seek a breakthrough that allows sweeping offensives and glorious cavalry charges; these never materialize. (World history) - 2006-02-27

truehistory.us.title: World War I: The "Great War" - Life and Death in the Trenches
truehistory.us.description: A detailed overview of the trench landscape from the perspective of ordinary soldiers; the elaborate fortifications; the omnipresence of death; the codes of behavior such as the Christmas fraternizations between the trenches in 1914. (World history) - 2006-02-27

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Hitler and the Nazi Youth
truehistory.us.description: The horrors of Nazi Germany are one hallmark of World War II; pondering how ordinary German citizens find themselves participating in such heinous events; going inside the propaganda machine of Hitler's Germany; seeing how it targets the youth. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Japanese Soldiers in Nanjing
truehistory.us.description: The origins of World War II lie in Asia in 1931; tracing the invasion of 1937 and the Rape of Nanjing; witnessing the events through the eyes of a Chinese soldier and a Japanese journalist, young men who bear witness to the flesh and blood of battle. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Panzer Leaders Who Changed Warfare
truehistory.us.description: In addition to the story of people, World War II is the story of technology; perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than the tanks Germany uses to barrel across Poland and France in "lightning warfare"; how new technology defeats the old ways of war. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - Jews Inside the Warsaw Ghetto
truehistory.us.description: Wartime Warsaw offers a gateway to the darkest events of the war; bearing witness as the city's Jews are rounded up and put in the ghetto, where the specter of disease and starvation always looms; stories from several of the ghetto's inhabitants. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - The Small Acts of the French Resistance
truehistory.us.description: In Nazi-occupied France, informants create an environment of paranoia and fear, yet some people offer resistance in ways big and small; revisiting the legacy of the French Resistance to experience life under the Nazi boot. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - A Child and a Pilot in the London Blitz
truehistory.us.description: Shifting one's attention across the English Channel, where Britain faces the Nazi war machine alone; tracing the war in London through the eyes of a Jewish child in the East End, a bureaucrat performing unglamorous duties and a young Oxford student. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - The Besieged at Leningrad
truehistory.us.description: When the Nazis set up a siege of Leningrad in 1941, none of the city's inhabitants can envision the impact; finding out what daily life is like inside "the Ring" of besieged Leningrad through the eyes and diaries of three unforgettable women. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - The Captured and Pursued in the Philippines
truehistory.us.description: Prior to the war, Americans in the Philippines live in a "soldier's paradise"; this changes when the Japanese invade the country; seeing what life is like after the fall of the Philippines, from the Bataan Death March to an internment camp in Manila. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War I: The "Great War" - The Century's Initial Catastrophe
truehistory.us.description: The opening lecture presents the main themes of the course; beginning with the concept of total war; other themes include the role of ideology, the meanings ascribed to the war by different sides and the war's legacy. (World history) - 2006-02-27

truehistory.us.title: World War I: The "Great War" - Europe in 1914
truehistory.us.description: Examining the state of Europe and the world before the onset of the war in 1914; the emergence of the German Empire creates strains in the international balance of power; divided among Great Britain, France, Germany, Austria-Hungary and Russia. (World history) - 2006-02-27

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - A Child and a Pilot in the London Blitz
truehistory.us.description: Shifting one's attention across the English Channel, where Britain faces the Nazi war machine alone; tracing the war in London through the eyes of a Jewish child in the East End, a bureaucrat performing unglamorous duties and a young Oxford student. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - The Besieged at Leningrad
truehistory.us.description: When the Nazis set up a siege of Leningrad in 1941, none of the city's inhabitants can envision the impact; finding out what daily life is like inside "the Ring" of besieged Leningrad through the eyes and diaries of three unforgettable women. (World history) - 2021-07-16

truehistory.us.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal - The Captured and Pursued in the Philippines
truehistory.us.description: Prior to the war, Americans in the Philippines live in a "soldier's paradise"; this changes when the Japanese invade the country; seeing what life is like after the fall of the Philippines, from the Bataan Death March to an internment camp in Manila. (World history) - 2021-07-16

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

700407.title: Gardeners' World

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don gets going with some autumn garden maintenance whilst looking back over the year and reviewing his borders - which plants have done well and others that haven't. As he clears annuals that are past their best he plans a colourful display for late spring by planting up the garden with tulips. Carol Klein is at Glebe Cottage continuing work on her new raised beds and taming an overgrown and unruly rambling rose.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty travels to two corners of the country where the challenges he faces are very different. On the south coast he is presented with a front garden ravaged by salty winds, and in Snowdonia he helps a mountainside garden.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty faces some of the most surprising plans yet - a Norwegian garden complete with waterfalls to be fashioned out of a tiny back yard in Dorset, and nothing less than a Japanese tea garden to be created out of a patch of ground in Bromley.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes. Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer. Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a young boy and his mother were kidnapped and murdered by a vicious drug cartel, FBI agents in the field worked tirelessly to pierce the secretive drug underworld and unearth those involved. Their surveillance and investigative work uncovered a violent trail of murder and greed. FBI agents and forensic examiners pieced together the evidence needed to draw out and then crush the cartel.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town. They turned to the FBI labs. The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim. Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move. Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A serial killer's rampage was discovered when the bodies of several young women began turning up in shallow graves that dotted the Alaskan wilderness. The killer taunted his victims, hunting them like animals before shooting them down. He was at home in the rugged terrain. But the hunt for him began 3000 miles away, where FBI profilers mapped the criminal's mind.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a judge and his politician wife were brutally murdered in their home. The killer left few clues and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI was patiently waiting in the wings. Once it was determined that federal laws had been violated, they pounced on the investigation. They uncovered a corrupt local government and a group of violent criminal conspirators known as the Dixie Mafia, responsible for fraud, money laundering and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Corruption in the New Orleans Police Department grew like a cancer in the early 1990's. Lured by the easy wealth of the narcotics industry, crooked cops began breaking the laws they were sworn to uphold. They would stop at nothing, including murder, to protect their rackets. When it became clear they could no longer police themselves, the FBI got involved. Putting their lives on the line, undercover agents devised a way to flush out the violent cops and restore trust in the city's police force.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Residents of the small town of Noel, Missouri were shocked when one of their banks was robbed. When the bank president was nowhere to be found, the residents were outraged. The FBI discovered that things are not always as they appear. Minute clues led the agents to the body of the bank president. With no suspects, the FBI relied on dogged determination and modern forensics. Agents slowly pieced together tiny shreds of evidence.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: From May until July of 1984, Alton Coleman and his common law wife, Denise Brown, engaged in a gruesome crime spree that spanned six states and left eight people dead including children. The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple. Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off. The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On August 20, 1980, an unseen sniper murdered two young black men as they jogged with two white women in Salt Lake City, Utah. Police threw all their resources into finding a killer who left almost no clues behind. They met with FBI agents and detectives from around the country who had similar racially motivated sniper slayings. A month later, working off little more than a possible license plate number, police in Kentucky arrested Joseph Paul Franklin but the man escaped from custody.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By April of 1995 in Washington, D.C., two officers had been shot and one had been murdered. Each had been sitting in their patrol cars when a man sneaked up and opened fire. The FBI was brought in to help catch the cop killer. Agents identified the man who was most likely the killer, but he was nowhere to be found. Months of surveillance operations around the country finally yielded a break; they found their suspect in Baltimore, MD.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Racial tensions in Buffalo in 1980 were at an all-time high. Six black males had been brutally murdered--two had their hearts cut out. The only thing connecting the victims was their ethnicity and the fact that each had been shot with .22 caliber bullets. Residents screamed for the police to stop this serial killer. With no suspects, local investigators turned to the FBI. Profilers were able to produce a psychological composite of the type of person the killer would most likely be. Their analysis paid off.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Diane Downs was convicted of the May 1983 murder of her daughter and attempted murder of her other two children, yet she told police a stranger had attempted to carjack her and had shot the children.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: A look at Gary Ridgway, also known as the Green River Killer, and his reign of mass murder across the Pacific Northwest for almost 20 years.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Serial killer, kidnapper, rapist, burglar, necrophile and pedophile Ted Bundy confessed to 30 homicides committed in seven states between 1974 and 1978.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Colin Ireland, 39 made a new year’s resolution in 1993 to become a serial killer and then murdered five Gay men in London. In 2006 he got a whole life term.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Angus Sinclair, the only living person to stand trial for Edinburgh's World's End Murders, was acquitted in 2007 in controversial circumstances.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: From November 1989 to November 1990, Aileen Wuornos killed at least six men all over Florida.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Robert Lee Yates kills 13 prostitutes in Spokane, Wash., between 1996 and 1998, and later confesses to two other murders committed in 1975 and 1988.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Robert Black was a Scottish serial killer and paedophile who was convicted of the kidnap, rape, sexual assault and murder of four girls aged between 5 and 11 in a series of killings committed between 1981 and 1986.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Mark Hobson killed four people in North Yorkshire, England in July 2004. Hobson committed his first 2 murders within 6 days of each other. He is currently serving a whole life sentence.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Bobby Joe Long is on Florida's death row for abducting, sexually assaulting and murdering at least 10 women in the Tampa Bay area during an eight-month period in 1984.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Serial killer Bob Berdella, aka the Kansas City Butcher, kidnaps, rapes, tortures, and murders at least six men between 1984 and 1987 in Kansas City, Mo., forcing his victims to endure periods of up to six weeks of captivity.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: In Cumbria, 2010 taxi driver Derek Bird takes his gun and, in less than 24 hours, kills 12 people and injures 11 more; the callous killer only stops when he runs out of ammunition, finally turning the gun on himself.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: In August 1990, Danny Rolling murdered five college students in Gainesville, Fla., home of the University of Florida, and created gruesome crime scenes that were designed to shock.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: 21 year old David Heiss, stabbed 20 year old Matthew Pyke 86 times after he became infatuated with Matthew’s girlfriend, Joanna. In May 2009 he was sentenced to life imprisonment with a minimum of 18 years in jail.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Dennis Rader, known to the world as the BTK Killer, killed ten people, including young children, between 1974 and 1991 in Wichita, Kansas.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: 30 year old Trevor Hardy known as ‘The Beast of Manchester’ killed three teenage girls in a series of brutal attacks in the mid to late 1970’s. He was given three life sentences and was one of Britain’s longest serving prisoners.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Christopher Halliwell, a 47 year old cab-driver, strangled a twenty year old woman and evaded justice for 8 years until his arrest for killing another young female. He finally got a whole life sentence in 2016.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: 44 year serial killer John Cooper known as ‘The Bullseye Killer’, killed four people between 1983 and 1996, he was given four life sentences.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: 32 year old Vincent Tabak strangled his neighbour 25 year Joanna Yeates to death in her own flat in December 2010. In 2011 he was given a life sentence, with a minimum of 20 years.

400000093.title: World's Most Evil Killers
400000093.description: Criminologists, forensic pathologists, federal agents, and other experts delve into the lives of the most terrifying and notorious killers in history.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: It's Halloween, and before Dog and Beth can help the kids carve their pumpkins, they have some business to attend to. It involves knocking on doors and meeting the neighbors but instead of hunting for treats they're on the search for a fugitive.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and the team have girl trouble in this case. Krystal jumped bail and seems to have vanished into the high plains of Colorado. To make matters worse, she's running with her lover (and bond co-signer) Carrie.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today Leland and Dog make a quick visit to the police supply store to get some new gadgets for the team. But they can't linger because they've also got a fugitive to catch. Their target is reputed to have an explosive temper.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When an offender with a long record ducks his day in court, Bobby Brown knows whom to call--The Dog! And knowing that few souls can resist Beth's clever persuasion, Dog gives her the job of luring the fugitive in.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog believes that the family that plays together stays together. But what happens when a family's idea of fun is getting high and running amuck? Today's case is a twofer, a brother and sister both charged with drug related offenses.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is always trying to reduce the number of fugitives in Hawaii, so he really doesn't like felons from the mainland combining their flight from the law with an island vacation.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: "When you don't write the bond, you don't know the prey," as Dog always says. So when Dog and team help out a bondsman friend whose client jumped bail, the target is a blank slate. Are his tattoos gang related? Is he likely to be violent?

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: They say you can't teach an old dog new tricks, but what if it's The Dog doing the teaching? Today's target is wanted on domestic abuse charges, but when Dog discovers she works for an escort service he opts for a new twist on an old ruse.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: So what does a bondsman do when he learns that the felon he's bonded out is booked on an afternoon flight to Florida? Especially when over $140,000 is at stake? If you're Dog, you 911 the team and race to Honolulu International.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog always wants to share the wisdom he has collected on the streets with the fugitives he captures. But today he's going to do double duty! His son-in-law Travis (and trainee bondsman) is also in need of some knowledge.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog knows that it is better to give than to receive, so when a fellow bondsman grieving for his recently departed spouse requests his help, he jumps into action. Studying the fugitive's file the team uncovers a surprising fact.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: No one becomes a bondsman overnight and even the members of Dog's team know there is always more to learn. So when Duane Lee cuts a felon a little too much slack about checking-in and then goes missing, Duane Lee knows he's gonna get schooled.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: What starts out as a perfect day for Dog turns ugly fast. He and Beth just bought bunnies for their kids, and Dog is enjoying helping them learn to care for their new pets. But duty calls and this is a tough case to fathom.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today the team isn't pulling any punches, literally or figuratively! In between tracking down a potentially dangerous ex-con facing a five year stretch in the big house, Leland is struggling to find time to train.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: It's Dog's birthday, and he plans to celebrate in the same way he has for the last twenty years. There's no taking the day off to indulge himself for this bounty hunter--he's tracking down a fugitive!

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: The "Big Island" of Hawaii boasts both lush tropical splendor and stark volcanic beauty. But today Dog and the team can't spend much time taking in the sights, they need to help Leland hunt down some elusive fugitives.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog knows that crime and drugs not only damage victims but also harm the families of the perpetrators, especially the kids. And both of the fugitives he's chasing today have left shattered families and struggling women in their wake.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog just can't resist a challenge, especially if it's to help out a friend. Jim is a bondsman and longtime friend of Dog. Jim's son has just started in the family business.
